Daedalus Fork v2.1.7 Android/Bionic release candidate.
Home-only popups FPS/VSync and internal resolution; mods/cheats selectable from Home; Settings owns Vulkan driver, language, HUD, saves/logs. Snapdragon GSR2 remains compiled, not exposed.
SpartanPort 2.6 file mods via Bionic overlay, seven FEX cheats + five-kind Automatic QTE. 8K beta resolution (7680x4320) uses upstream 16-site eboot signature/sha verification and must fail closed. No game eboot redistributed.
Compile and package release APK; not proven on-device until runtime reports.
